_comment: Reproducible source for USFS National Forest System (NFS) Trails — the
national bulk shapefile from the USFS Enterprise Data Warehouse, converted to
converted `data/usfs/trails.geojson` at ingest time but has no way to obtain
it itself — this manifest is the durable, checked-in record of where it came
from (mirrors `regions/dem_manifest.json`'s role for the elevation raster).
`sha256` is null until an operator runs a real fetch and commits the observed
value back — we do not fabricate it (source-or-silence, CLAUDE.md rule #1).
`vintage` is the USFS EDW page's stated publication/update date for
S_USA.TrailNFS_Publish, recorded by hand since the zip carries no
machine-readable date field — also left null until an operator checks the
EDW page at fetch time and records it, so a stale download is distinguishable
from a fresh one rather than silently assumed current.
